scope: Lagoon Finance DeTrade Core USDC v0.5.0 Base vault: exact ordinary asynchronous USDC request, cancel-deposit, settled share/asset claim overloads, bundled self claim-and-request-redeem, and conditional valid-NAV synchronous deposit. No Safe executors, curator settlement, role/admin, permit or bridge.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official Lagoon active vault directory lists DeTrade Core USDC and its exact current product page offers DEPOSIT, Base USDC, curator, role, version v0.5.0 and market-specific total deposited approximately $676.65K. Reviewed official sources contain no closed/retired/wind-down notice for this vault. This source binds the still-listed current v0.5.0 deployment rather than assuming that newer v0.6.0 features apply. UI total deposited and performance are snapshots, not independently verified balances or DAU; no aggregate TVL is attributed as this vault TVL.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official exact vault URL and page identify Base chain, 0x8092ca384d44260ea4feaf7457b629b8dc6f88f0, USDC underlying 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 and v0.5.0. BaseScan exact proxy page displays BeaconProxy and implementation 0xE50554ec802375C9c3F9c087a8a7bb8C26d3DEDf. On-page constructor/deployed beacon literal is 0xee6a60be216058afd7a0643795b4f1e197c8b150. Sourcify proxyResolution independently reports the same Vault implementation. Only vault proxy is admitted; custody Safe is not an executor target.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full applicable implementation ABI and source obtained from the exact deployed implementation through Sourcify v2, resolved from exact proxy. Match labels are recorded verbatim. No generic ERC4626 ABI substitution and no fresh RPC identity/execution assertion.

selectedFunctions.label: Cancel pending deposit
warnings: Catalog review records static deployment/ABI evidence only; no fresh RPC bytecode/storage attestation, funding/liquidity check or successful execution is asserted. Independent authorization, pause, calldata and execution controls remain mandatory.
Exact Base USDC DeTrade Core vault v0.5.0 only, not every Lagoon vault or v0.6 interface. USDC calls require zero native value and appropriate asset allowance.
Asynchronous request -> curator valuation/settlement -> claim; no guaranteed settlement deadline. v0.5.0 requestRedeem cannot be cancelled.
requestDeposit requires expired NAV; syncDeposit requires currently valid NAV and Open state. Both are conditional ordinary user entrypoints, not an execution guarantee.
Whitelist/owner/operator/allowance and pause rules remain enforced. Fees, NAV and curator strategy risk apply; no access/qualification bypass.
Claims support partial amounts, unlike Spectra wrapper claims. syncDeposit has no explicit min-shares parameter; the caller must independently constrain execution and value.
